def transform(grid):
    # A solid-color horizontal divider separates two equal-sized masks.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != 0)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0
             for a, b in zip(top[r], bottom[r])]
            for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
